user.title: Connect to Cinema Frame
user.description: Enter the frame LAN address. Use port 8787 for Cinema playback, or 8788 for Frame Diagnostics screen, brightness and app control. Add each connection separately. A pairing code will appear on the frame.

pair.title: Pair the frame
pair.description: Enter the six-digit code displayed on the frame. This creates a separate Home Assistant session; existing phone and Spotify connections are preserved.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Cinema Frame. Check the app, address and network.
error.invalid_host: Enter only a hostname or IPv4 address, without URL or port.
error.invalid_auth: Incorrect code. Read the six-digit code on the frame and try again.
